structured_output.rationale: No run was accepted, so there was nothing to flag or clear. All three runs were declined and closure failed on every one, so the condition comparison is only context and is not a reported result.
structured_output.text:
Batch: 3 runs (r01 mannitol then control, r02 control, r03 mannitol). Accepted: 0. Flagged: 0. Cleared: 0. All 3 were declined, so there was nothing to audit.
What the declined runs share: closure failed on all three (r01 4.66, r02 64.19, r03 4.52; threshold 1.0). No remedy was kept in any run, and r01 and r03 each had one roll-back. Rigid-body invariance (threshold 2.0) and plane sections (threshold 3.25) were reported but did not gate the outcome on these real movies, and both were far above threshold on every run. The worst case is r02 (rigid-body invariance 63.4), which points to a tracker failure.
Condition comparison (context only, from declined measurements):
- Control (r02): centre REGR peak 36.5 %/h at 116 um, growth zone 105 um, largest flank difference +39.2 %/h at 84 um. This profile is much shorter and sits nearer the tip than the others (z about -2.7), which fits the tracker failure rather than a real control response.
- Mannitol (r03): peak 51.0 %/h at 579 um, growth zone 779 um, largest flank difference -28.8 %/h at 547 um. The peak's z of 11.1 is large partly because the batch MAD is small (0.88), but the difference is still real: about 14.5 %/h above the median, roughly 40 %. Peak position and growth-zone length are like the batch.
- Mannitol then control (r01): peak 35.6 %/h at 695 um, growth zone 642 um, largest flank difference -9.6 %/h at 916 um.
None of these runs passed closure, so no condition difference in strain rate or curvature rate can be reported from this batch.
